stemMd: A flat square lies parallel to the frontal projection plane but is tilted relative to the horizontal plane. Which orthographic view shows its true shape and size?

options.label: E
options.textMd: No view can show true shape

explanationMd: A plane figure appears in true size in orthographic projection onto a plane parallel to it. The given square is parallel to the frontal plane. Its inclination to the horizontal plane prevents a true-size plan.

distractorRationale.a: A plane tilted to the horizontal projection plane is foreshortened in plan.
distractorRationale.d: Only a parallel projection plane shows true planar shape.
distractorRationale.e: The square is explicitly parallel to one projection plane.
distractorRationale.c: Perspective generally introduces scale variation and is unnecessary here.
